name: Apriel Voice 27B Preview

lineage.base_model: Gemma 4 backbone (config: Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration; the text comparison column is Gemma 4 26B-A4B)
lineage.how_derived: speech interface added to the Gemma 4 backbone, keeping text and image input

purpose: Open model for speech, reasoning and tool use: understands spoken requests, reasons over conversation context, returns text and tool calls; pair it with an external synthesizer for voice assistants and support workflows (card).

license.name: MIT (card tag)
license.notes: HF API cardData.license mit; no LICENSE file in the repo (404).

architecture.kind: speech-interface added to a Gemma 4 text/vision backbone (custom code); active-parameter count not stated in the card parts read

pc-12gb.notes: 54.5 GB file against 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; part streams from RAM (dense: decode is bandwidth bound)

pc-16gb.notes: 54.5 GB file against 13.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; part streams from RAM (dense: decode is bandwidth bound)

pc-24gb.notes: 54.5 GB file against 21.6 GB VRAM plus 82 GB RAM budget; part streams from RAM (dense: decode is bandwidth bound)

pc-32gb.notes: 54.5 GB file against 29.6 GB VRAM plus 114 GB RAM budget; part streams from RAM (dense: decode is bandwidth bound); BF16 does not fit VRAM; a 4-bit quant would, none seen yet

mac-16-24gb.notes: 54.5 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 54.5 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 54.5 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

other: vLLM serving examples in the card (30-minute audio settings)

strengths: spoken tool use and reasoning at near text-model level (card tables)
weaknesses: preview; needs external TTS and application-managed turn taking

tona_fit.reason: An open speech-in, tool-calling model with 24+ languages including German and MIT licence, based on the same Gemma 4 family that Tona users run for text. Large in BF16, but a Gemma-4-sized MoE-class model quantizes well; needs a German speech-QA test.
blockers: audio front end not in Tona

sources.note: README with benchmark tables, config.json, HF API

open_questions: Active parameter count and expert layout
